sources.title: Long-Term Care Ombudsman
sources.source_date: none stated on the page body; a linked document is dated 03/08/2022
sources.notes: www.dhhs.nh.gov returns HTTP 403 to curl over HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 with a browser user-agent (2026-09-22), as recorded in CLAUDE.md, and the page loads normally in the session browser, so the transport is chrome (a session reader, not an attended source: no human step is needed). Supply document.querySelector('main').innerText from the rendered page, unedited, with extractor none; it carries the site's own menu labels and a trailing 'Escape Site' link, left in rather than trimmed by hand. Transfer the text to the Mac through escaped JSON and check its SHA-256 against the in-page digest (crypto.subtle) before supplying it. KNOWN LIMIT (FA-Q-20260919-02, FA-D-20260922-04): the department prints each contact address as five adjacent inline fields with no separator in the markup, so innerText and every extractor render e.g. 'Brown Building129 Pleasant StreetConcordNH03301'. That is the publisher's markup, reproduced; the 2026-09-01 hand capture's ', ' joins were ours. check-fidelity's address layer cannot find a street address that runs straight into the next word, so a page line citing the address fails the ADDRESS check against this capture.

sources.title: NH Medicaid Nursing Facilities and Swing Bed Hospitals Provider Manual, Volume II — Section 2, Provider Participation & Ongoing Responsibilities, p.2-1, excerpt
sources.source_date: cover page reads "September, 2020"; the running page footer throughout reads "NH Medicaid Nursing Facilities and Swing Bed Hospitals – December 2017" (the document is internally inconsistent about its own date)

slice.from: 2. Provider Participation & Ongoing Responsibilities All Nursing Facilities

sources.notes: nhmmis.nh.gov serves the manual to plain curl, but its Incapsula bot-mitigation intermittently answers the same request with a ~200-byte text/html challenge (seen 2026-09-22: four challenged fetches, then ten clean ones, across header sets and HTTP versions; 2026-09-22 queue entry FA-Q-20260922-01 recorded the challenge persisting across a cookie jar). A challenged fetch fails this source (pdftotext rejects it), it does not produce a short packet; re-run later, and if the challenge persists, obtain the PDF in an attended session and supply it with --supply-file and its SHA-256. The 41-page PDF is extracted with pdftotext -layout, as the hand capture was. Sliced on section 2's own body heading to its page-2-1 footer: a superset of the hand capture, which began mid-list at '1. Plans of care'; widened to the heading so a revision that renumbers the list cannot move the anchor.
